class.name: OcgBrepbuilderapiMakevertex
class.brief_description: Describes functions to build BRepBuilder vertices directly from 3D geometric points. A vertex built using a MakeVertex object is only composed of a 3D point and a default precision value (Precision::Confusion()). Later on, 2D representations can be added, for example, when inserting a vertex in an edge. A MakeVertex object provides a framework for: - defining and implementing the construction of a vertex, and - consulting the result.

method.name: BRepBuilderAPI_MakeVertex
method.description: Constructs a vertex from point P. Example create a vertex from a 3D point. gp_Pnt P(0,0,10); TopoDS_Vertex V = BRepBuilderAPI_MakeVertex(P);
